title: Dual-event priority capture with lockout

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.

requirements.text: Reset shall clear Captured, Code, and Pulse.
While armed and not captured, a rising EventA shall capture Code 1.
requirements.property: G((Arm AND !prev(Captured) AND rose(EventA) AND !Reset) -> (Captured AND (Code = 1) AND Pulse))

requirements.text: A simultaneous rising edge shall select EventA over EventB.
requirements.property: G((Arm AND rose(EventA) AND rose(EventB) AND !prev(Captured) AND !Reset) -> (Code = 1))

requirements.text: A rising EventB without EventA shall capture Code 2.
requirements.property: G((Arm AND !prev(Captured) AND !rose(EventA) AND rose(EventB) AND !Reset) -> (Code = 2))

requirements.text: After capture, later events shall not change Code until Reset.
